status: Prospective acceptance protocol; current pilots do not pass it
primary_objective: Interactive P95 improvement at fixed model, hardware, memory cap and quality
baseline: Strongest compatible tuned native baseline including native caching and continuous batching; a weak one-slot uncached baseline is insufficient

quality.exact_paths: Exact token-ID equality for all evaluated greedy requests

minimum_measurement_scope: Power/sample planning must precede confirmatory P95 claims; existing n=10 pilots are exploratory
latency_requirements: Preserve identical exogenous arrival traces across arms
Do not condition arrivals on a faster arms completion for a throughput claim
Record actual EOS/output lengths and never silently force or exclude them
Report queue, first-text, total, long-request slowdown, throughput, makespan and failures
evaluation_isolation: Development trace seeds and held-out confirmation seeds must remain separate; do not select a favorable evaluation mix after seeing results
stop_rule: After overhead profiling and two admission/scheduling iterations, review unchanged gates and narrow or pivot if no useful win exists
